problem: A five-viewport sweep across every sitemap route makes the daily screenshot gate unnecessarily long and risks runner timeout.
root_cause: Deep responsive coverage and full-route coverage were multiplied instead of layered.
decision: Use a bounded two-layer gate: every route at 320px and 1440px, while critical route families retain all five widths and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit.
prevention: All sitemap routes still receive mobile+desktop responsive verification.
Critical routes retain 320/390/768/1440/1920 and three engines.
